requirements: Must show the full page including MRZ code at the bottom.
Passport must be valid for at least 6 months from arrival date with at least 3 blank pages.

documents.name: Business Invitation Letter
documents.notes: Upload an invitation letter from the host company or organization in Sri Lanka.
requirements: Must be on the host company's official letterhead.
Must state the purpose and duration of the visit.
Must be signed by an authorized representative of the company.

importantNotes: Government fee is 35 USD for SAARC (including Indian) nationals.
Business ETA is valid for 6 months from date of issue, with multiple entries allowed. The stay is limited to 30 days per entry.
Ensure all details match your passport exactly. Typos will lead to visa rejection.
